body: Azure Policy is a service for creating, assigning and managing rules that control or audit your resources, so their settings stay compliant with your standards. A group of related policies is called an initiative. Policies can be set on a resource, a resource group or a subscription, and everything inside inherits them. Azure Policy can stop noncompliant resources from being created, and it also checks resources that already exist. For example, a policy can allow only certain virtual machine sizes. In some cases it can fix problems automatically, such as adding a missing tag.
